name: mega-sdd
description: Spec-Driven Development as an autonomous agent pipeline: extract → intent → scan → bind → units → bolts. Anti-hallucination by construction — every claim cites its source, and spec↔code binding (CONFIRMED / CONFLICT / OQ verdicts) gates code generation. AST-precise codebase analysis (ast-grep-validated Hard Rules + symbol/reuse index), first-class subagents, and a consolidated /analyze consistency surface. Optional native deps (ast-grep + ripgrep) with graceful regex fallback.
